description: Phase 1 of the settled q67.21 course. Port of FDB's MoveKeys lock (MoveKeys.actor.cpp:286-391): two system keys distributor_lock/{owner,write} holding opaque UIDs, and a pure fencing protocol: take (read both, remember prev_owner/prev_write, write fresh my_owner to owner - NOT the write key), check three-way branch inside every mutating transaction (owner==prev_owner: verify write==prev_write else superseded, then assert owner=my_owner + fresh write; owner==my_owner: touch write with fresh UID; else superseded), and a read-only poll verdict for the 5s poll-to-die loop. Pure functions over read values returning mutations - the transaction runner arrives in phase 4. Every write proves inside its own serializable commit that no newer owner appeared: ownership enforcement lives in the keyspace.
title: Distributor lock: keys + read-check-write fencing helper
